list_defs_add.label: Controller for the VAVs
list_defs_add.note: VAV boxes only. Read THIS row's whole payload (its description, its own notes and the notes of the headings above it): is a controller FOR CONTROLLING THE VAVs mentioned? Only a controller that is for controlling the VAVs counts. 'ddc_inclusive' = a DDC controller or DDC panel (the two are the same thing) is part of the VAV box or its controller and the text makes it part of the price (e.g. 'Independent DDC VAV Controller with inbuilt pressure sensor', a box 'consisting of' / 'complete with' ... a DDC controller, 'inclusive of DDC controller'). 'ddc' = a DDC controller or DDC panel is part of the VAV box or its controller but the text does not say it is included. 'bacnet' = BACnet in any form (BACnet over IP, BACnet MS/TP, BACnet alone) for the VAV box, its controller or the VAV network. 'controller' = a controller for the VAVs with neither a DDC nor a BACnet word (e.g. 'controller for receiving Temp. & DP Signal', 'required controllers for controlling all the VAVs', the VAVs 'shall communicate through a network controller'). 'none' = no controller for the VAVs. NOT counted (answer as if those words were absent): a DDC or BACnet controller of OTHER equipment (an AHU's 'BACNET/IP DDC', a 'centralised controller for VFD operation'); a line about makes ('All VAV controllers, DDC controllers ... shall be of single OEM' names no DDC for the VAVs - its BACnet controllers still count as 'bacnet' when BACnet is named for the VAVs). When more than one applies, answer the first of: ddc_inclusive, ddc, bacnet, controller.

list_defs_add.label: Controller by others
list_defs_add.note: VAV boxes only: 'Yes' when the text says the VAV controller is supplied or installed by the BMS vendor or by others (e.g. '(VAV controllers and thermostats will be installed by the BMS vendor at site)'); otherwise 'No'.

list_defs_add.label: DP sensor mentioned
list_defs_add.note: VAV boxes only: 'Yes' when THIS row's payload mentions a DP sensor for the VAVs in any form - a differential pressure sensor, switch or transmitter, a 'DP sensor' / 'DPS', a duct static pressure sensor; every DP sensor mention counts. 'No' otherwise. A 'DP signal' alone, a pressure gauge, an air-flow monitoring station or the box's own velocity sensor is not a DP sensor.

list_def_notes_append.vav_item: A duct connection only when the row ASKS for one (e.g. 'with flexible duct connection'); a row that only says the box is 'suitable for duct connections' describes the box - that is NOT a duct connection item.
list_def_notes_append.airflow_cfm: A lower limit only ('Above 3200 CFM', '3700 CFM above'): copy it with its word, e.g. 'Above 3200 CFM'.
list_def_notes_append.qty_per_box: Two of an item when the row asks for two ('two thermostats'; a piece 'on either side' = 2).

section_family_notes.misc: Which Misc item goes with THIS VAV box: Digital Thermostat (a thermostat for the box; a thermostat with a CO2 sensor or a CO2 display is TWO items - this Digital Thermostat and a CO2 Sensor under Sensor); Temperature Gauge / Thermometer = Room temperature sensor - priced at Misc's Temperature Gauge / Thermometer (a room temperature sensor with no thermostat); Transformation Pieces (a transition / transformation piece between the box and the duct). Answer 'none of these' for anything else and copy its words into 'Item as written'.
section_family_notes.sensors: Which sensor goes with THIS VAV box: CO2 Sensor (a CO2 sensor, also one that comes with a thermostat - a thermostat with a CO2 sensor or a CO2 display is TWO items: the Digital Thermostat under Misc item and this CO2 Sensor). A DP / differential pressure / duct static pressure sensor is NOT an item here: answer it in 'DP sensor mentioned' on the VAV box. Answer 'none of these' for anything else and copy its words into 'Sensor as written'.
